title: Planta Watering Overdue Queue
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=planta:plant care_status="watering_due"
| stats max(days_since_watered) as days_since_watered by plant_name room_name
| sort - days_since_watered
description: Builds an ordered queue of plants that are currently overdue for watering.
value: An overdue queue is more actionable than a generic reminder because it tells you exactly which plants need help first.
implementation: Export Planta reminders with plant and room context, then rank the current watering queue by days overdue.
visualization: Table of overdue plants grouped by room.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which plants are first in line for a drink right now.
